name: Flower Beam
desc: Gathers sunlight and fires a solar beam from which sharp leaves sprout on both sides; where it ends, an explosion of petals blooms.

fixed: The leaves pierce 2 enemies.

name: Fiery Whirlwind
desc: Launches a fire whirl that pulls in enemies and feeds it with a Flamethrower: it grows, spits spiraling flames and explodes.

name: Hydro Spiral
desc: You spin inside your shell and push nearby enemies away while two Hydro Pump jets sweep everything around you like a sprinkler.

name: Ball Storm
desc: Launches a big electric ball that floats over the horde and acts as a lightning rod: thunder strikes it and chains outward until it falls and explodes.

fixed: A thunderbolt strikes the ball every 0.3 seconds.

name: Resonant Web
desc: Throws silk webs that stick to the ground and trap; then a buzz makes them vibrate and each web releases a sound wave that punishes the trapped more.

fixed: The waves sound twice and trapped enemies take 50% more damage.

name: Lethal Sting
desc: Calls a swarm of Beedrill that dive with their stingers; where they sting they leave toxic spikes on the ground.

name: Feather Cyclone
desc: A hurricane advances on the enemies dragging them along, and cutting wings fly out of it nonstop, back and forth.

count.text: Cutting Wings: come out faster (rate ×2 at +2, ×3 at +4)

fixed: The wings pierce all enemies.

name: Ravenous Chomp
desc: Fangs leap from enemy to enemy biting each one; each bite also tears away 6% of its remaining health (not bosses).

fixed: Each enemy takes only one bite per cast.

name: Celestial Drill
desc: A drill beak falls from the sky onto the enemy, sinks into the earth and comes out again beneath three others, one after another.

name: Corrosive Grime
desc: A pile of garbage falls on the enemies and leaves an acid puddle that poisons and corrodes: those who step in it take more damage.

name: Seismic Ball
desc: A rock ball rolls in circles around you; each bounce shakes the ground and at the end it lands with a great earthquake.

name: Toxic Tide
desc: A wave of poison leaves you in a circle; enemies that were already poisoned burst into splashes that infect those beside them.

fixed: At most 12 poisoned enemies burst.

name: Tectonic Horn
desc: A ghostly horn charges in a straight line and splits the ground: along the fissure, earth geysers burst one after another.

name: Gravitational Moon
desc: A small moon appears over the enemies and pulls them in with its gravity; then it falls and bursts into star shards.

name: Nine-Tail Dance
desc: Nine will-o'-wisps spin around you like tails and launch one by one at the enemies; each bursts into a ring of psychic fire that burns and confuses.

name: Grand Concert
desc: A lullaby puts the surrounding enemies to sleep and, once they are asleep, a huge booming voice hits them hard and wakes them.

name: Vampire Wing
desc: A supersonic echo marks the surrounding enemies and air blades seek the marked and return part of the life they steal.

fixed: Healing is capped at 1.5% of your max HP per cast.

name: Dancing Garden
desc: The petals spinning around you open into a spiral storm and close again; they hit on the way out and back and leave clouds of poison dust.

fixed: Leaves 4 clouds of poison powder.

name: Fungal Bomb
desc: Throws energy balls that make a mushroom sprout where they land; the mushroom releases sleep spores and soon bursts.

name: Scale Prism
desc: Releases a cloud of silver scales ahead and fires a signal beam at it: the scales refract it into a fan of colored beams.

fixed: The fan always covers the same angle.

name: Dugtrio's Fissure
desc: A fissure runs along the ground toward the enemies; along it Diglett and Dugtrio pop up and spit mud at those nearby.

name: Golden Rain
desc: Coins rain on the surrounding enemies, then you leap into a playful scuffle in a dust cloud where they pile up most.

name: Torrential Migraine
desc: A jet soaks the enemies ahead and Psyduck's headache bursts into psychic orbs on the wet ones, splashing those beside them.

fixed: Psychic orbs only fall on wet enemies.

name: Unleashed Tantrum
desc: Throws fists of rage that chase the enemies, and every hit makes the ground tremble. The less health you have left, the harder it hits.

fixed: Hits up to 60% harder the less HP you have left.

name: Fiery Stampede
desc: A fire silhouette leaves you at full speed and zigzags between several enemies leaving a burning trail; at the end it explodes.

name: Hypnotic Spiral
desc: A great hypnotic spiral turns on the ground and pulses, lulling enemies to sleep, while bubble beams spiral out of it.

name: Prismatic Premonition
desc: Marks several enemies with runes; shortly after, rifts open in the air around them and Psybeams converge on them.

fixed: Psybeams follow the marked enemy.

name: Four-Arm Combo
desc: Four lightning-fast strikes in a cross against four enemies and, to finish, a Dynamic Punch whose shockwave confuses everything nearby.

name: Carnivorous Whip
desc: Throws vines that catch up to three enemies and drag them toward you; then acid jaws bite everything around you.

name: Jellyfish Whirl
desc: A whirlpool pulls in the enemies; tentacles sprout around it and poison jumps in a chain among all the trapped.

name: Magnitude 10
desc: An earthquake of random magnitude between 4 and 10: the higher it is, the harder it shakes and the more rocks fall from the sky.

fixed: The magnitude, from 4 to 10, is rolled on each cast.

name: Gloomy Curse
desc: A Shadow Ball bursts and curses; then misfortune jumps from enemy to enemy with will-o'-wisps and deals double damage to those suffering any status.

fixed: Deals double damage to enemies with any status.

name: Dance of Bones
desc: A bone and a dark bone trace figure eights around you, hitting everything they cross; the dark one leaves a trail of ghostly fire.

name: Celestial Cross Slash
desc: Four giant air slashes arrive from the corners and cross in an X over the enemy, where they burst into a gale of blades.

fixed: Each cast makes at most 3 crossings.

name: Gyarados's Fury
desc: A waterfall bursts from the ground, Gyarados emerges from it and sweeps a huge arc with a Hyper Beam.

name: Glacial Tide
desc: A wave advances and freezes as it goes into a wall of ice that soon bursts into freezing shards.

fixed: The ice wall bursts at 9 points at most.

name: Star Gambit
desc: Meteors' stars spin around you, gather over the enemy and fall as a giant star of your current form's type.

fixed: The 6 shooting stars pierce 3 enemies.

name: Crushing Nap
desc: A huge shadow grows over the enemies and Snorlax drops like a stone: the ground trembles in waves and, after the blow, it takes a little nap that heals you a bit.

fixed: After the hit, heals you for 1.5% of your max HP.

name: Draconic Rain
desc: You fire a Dragon Pulse into the sky that splits into a rain of draconic comets on the enemies; each one leaves violet fire.

name: Primeval Bubble
desc: A pink bubble grows over the enemies and traps them inside; when it pops, it strikes them with psychic force and moonlight.

fixed: Bosses are barely pulled in by the bubble.

name: Sacred Gallop
desc: A fire Rapidash gallops between the enemies leaving burning hoofprints, and columns of sacred fire fall in its wake.

fixed: Always leaves 3 burning footprints.

name: Psychic Geyser
desc: A psychic ring expands from you and, as it passes, geysers of boiling water burst that burn and confuse.

name: Magnetic Field
desc: Magnets stick to several enemies and pull them against each other; then a Flash Cannon pierces the pile.

fixed: Bosses are barely pulled in by the magnets.

name: Starry Leek
desc: The leek falls from the sky like a meteor wrapped in feathers and stars, and its impact releases a shockwave and shooting stars.

fixed: The shooting stars pierce 2 enemies.

name: Triple Ruckus
desc: Three heads peck three different enemies at once, three times in a row, while their racket stuns everyone around.

fixed: 3 waves of pecks and uproar in a row.

name: Aurora Borealis
desc: Aurora curtains descend from the sky and sweep over enemies, freezing them; then a polar chill bursts and deals double damage to the frozen.

fixed: Frozen enemies take double, except bosses and mini-bosses.

name: Sludge Tide
desc: A sludge belch floods the ground in front of you and leaves toxic puddles that spit waste balls at nearby enemies.

fixed: Each puddle spits out 2 waste balls.

name: Icicle Rain
desc: Fires icicles into the sky that fall in a circle on the enemies and stay stuck for a moment; at the end a giant icicle drops.

name: Rock Snake
desc: A rock serpent advances underground in a zigzag: its rocks burst the ground as it passes and leave sharp stone traps.

name: Dreamy Feast
desc: A pendulum puts surrounding enemies to sleep and steals their dreams: energy beams run from the sleepers to you, damaging them and healing you.

fixed: Heals up to 1.5% of your max HP.

name: Tsunami Claw
desc: A giant claw falls from the sky and strikes the ground; the impact sends out a wave that wipes out everything ahead of you.

count.text: Water Wave: wider (base width 3: 4 at +2, 5 at +4)

name: Chain Reaction
desc: Drops Voltorbs around you that sizzle and explode one after another: each explosion sets off the next.

fixed: Explosions chain from the nearest to the farthest.

name: Explosive Harvest
desc: Throws eggs that burst into seeds; a palm tree sprouts from each one and crashes down on the surrounding enemies.

name: Hurricane Kick
desc: A flurry of spinning kicks raises a whirlwind that advances on the enemies; at the end, a kick falls from the sky like a meteor.

name: Glacial Fist
desc: Focuses power into an icy fist that freezes the enemies ahead; a second precise blow shatters them.

fixed: Sure-hit Punch hits frozen enemies harder.

name: Giant Lick
desc: A huge tongue sweeps an arc in front of you, catches the enemies and slams them into the ground with all its weight.

fixed: The tongue catches each enemy only once.

name: Detonating Cloud
desc: Clouds of toxic smoke spread among the enemies and poison them; then they ignite and explode one after another.

name: Megalithic Charge
desc: A ghost rhino charges in a straight line trampling everything; at the end of its run a huge boulder falls.

name: Sonic Egg
desc: Throws lucky eggs that crack open with a bang: each one releases sound waves and a bit of energy that heals you.

fixed: Each egg heals 0.5% of your max HP, up to 4 eggs.

name: Solar Tangle
desc: Vines catch nearby enemies and drain their life; then a blade of sunlight cuts all the entangled.

fixed: The blade hits entangled enemies harder.

name: Parental Double
desc: Mother and child attack together: a Mega Punch and a Mega Kick on the same enemy, twice in a row, and every blow shakes those around.

fixed: Each round brings one Mega Punch and one Mega Kick.

name: Abyssal Ink
desc: Fires ink balls that blind enemies; shortly after, a Hydro Cannon falls from the sky onto each ink stain.

name: Torpedo Horn
desc: A water torpedo with a steel horn chases the enemies, pierces them one after another and ends with a bite that raises a wave.

count.text: Horn Torpedo: 4 base jumps, +1 per +1 (up to 8)

fixed: The torpedo never hits the same target twice.

name: Photon Star
desc: A water star spins toward the enemies and, as it spins, fires beams of light in all directions; when it stops, it bursts into a geyser of photons.

fixed: The beams hit every 0.15 seconds.

name: Explosive Wall
desc: Raises four crystal panels that enclose a group of enemies and sets off a fairy mist inside the box.

fixed: The box lasts 1.1 seconds and Duration does not extend it.

name: Glacial Kiss
desc: Throws kisses that put enemies ahead to sleep and charm them, then blows an icy breath that freezes the kissed.

fixed: Kisses put to sleep or charm with an 80% chance.
The icy breath is more likely to freeze kissed enemies.

name: Flashing Cage
desc: Traps a group in a cage of lightning that paralyzes them and unleashes a Discharge from the sky inside it.

fixed: The cage lasts 1.1 seconds and the bolt strikes right at the end.

name: Volcanic Eruption
desc: A volcano rises from the ground in front of you, belches burning smoke and spits lava bombs that rain around it.

fixed: One in every three bombs leaves a lava puddle.

name: Titanic Guillotine
desc: Grabs the nearest enemy with its horns, flips it and hurls it into the horde: where it lands, a brutal shockwave bursts.

fixed: Grabs and throws a single enemy.

name: Stampede
desc: Calls a herd of Tauros that charges the enemies one after another: each goring blow lifts the ground and sends them flying.

name: Metamorfusion
desc: Ditto transforms with every cast: it copies the signature fusion of a random League member.

info.skipCheck: Lanza la receta de firma de otro miembro elegido al azar
fixed: Copies the signature fusion of another random member.
What your upgrades improve depends on the fusion that comes up.

name: Binary Overload
desc: Three data cubes orbit around you linked by Fusion Bolt arcs and fire Techno Blasts at nearby enemies.

fixed: One cube fires a Techno Shock every 0.4 seconds.

name: Ancient Deluge
desc: The shell gathers water and fires a meteor beam into the sky; the sky answers with torrents of water and rocks on the enemies.

name: Fossil Slash
desc: Two scythes slash in a cross in front of you, and sharp spinning shells fly out of the cut, piercing the enemies.

fixed: The shells pierce 6 enemies.

name: Prehistoric Dive
desc: A winged shadow dives from the sky with electric fangs and crashes in a paralyzing blast.

fixed: The dive lands 0.6 seconds after marking the ground.

name: Ice Age
desc: An icy gale of ice feathers sweeps what is ahead and behind it a wave of ice covers the ground and freezes the enemies.

fixed: The ice wave advances for half a second.

name: Supreme Storm
desc: Charges and fires an electro beam that pierces everything; wherever it passes a storm breaks out and lightning strikes along its path.

fixed: The electro beam lasts 0.45 seconds.

name: Phoenix Sun
desc: A fire phoenix dives onto the enemies and bursts into a small sun that scorches everything.

fixed: The phoenix takes 0.6 seconds to dive.

name: Genetic Supremacy
desc: Psychic fragments spin around you and lodge in the enemies; then a Psyshock falls and mind-wave beams cross it in a star shape.

fixed: The fragments pierce 2 enemies.

name: Hyper Star
desc: A huge star falls from the sky onto the nearest enemy and its shockwave sends shooting stars in all directions.

fixed: The shooting stars pierce 3 enemies.

name: Scorching Sun
desc: A small sun forms above the enemies, flames rain around them and it finally bursts in a ring of fire.

name: Tidal Wave
desc: A circular wave leaves you and sweeps everyone along, and behind it geysers burst under the enemies.

name: Primeval Forest
desc: Six thorny roots run along the ground in a star shape, trap whatever they cross, and where they end a tree sprouts and drops leaves.

name: Electric Storm
desc: For a few seconds lightning strikes nonstop on the enemies around you, paralyzing them.

name: Eternal Blizzard
desc: A blizzard spins around you and freezes; at the end ice crystals sprout under the frozen and burst.

name: Thousand Fists
desc: A rain of punches falls on nearby enemies one after another and ends with an uppercut that cracks the ground.

name: Toxic Swamp
desc: Throws four sludge bombs that leave toxic puddles; the puddles bubble and poison nonstop.

name: Seismic Fault
desc: You stomp hard: three cracks run along the ground toward the enemies and burst into columns of earth.

name: Typhoon
desc: A tornado advances on the enemies dragging them along and hitting them nonstop, with sharp feathers flying off.

fixed: The feathers pierce 2 enemies.

name: Mind Warp
desc: Three psychic waves leave you: the first pulls enemies in, the second confuses them and the third crushes them.

name: Swarm
desc: A swarm of insects bursts from you and rushes at nearby enemies, stinging and poisoning.

fixed: The bugs seek enemies up to 14 m away, regardless of Area.

name: Meteorite Shower
desc: Flaming rocks fall from the sky onto the surrounding enemies; each one bursts into shards.

name: Spectral Parade
desc: Eight will-o'-wisps spin around you and launch one after another at the enemies, burning and cursing.

fixed: They seek enemies up to 14 m away, regardless of Area.

name: Ancestral Fury
desc: You roar and dragon flames rain on the enemies; where they land they leave violet fire.

name: Pitch Black
desc: Darkness falls around you and shadow claws tear through every enemy trapped in it, one after another.

name: Steel Rain
desc: Six steel blades spin around you striking those nearby and then shoot out at the enemies.

fixed: The thrown blades pierce 4 enemies.

name: Fairy Halo
desc: A halo of light surrounds you and pulses three times: it charms enemies, hits them and heals you a little.

fixed: Heals you for 2% of your max HP.

name: Conductive Storm
desc: A rain soaks the surrounding enemies and lightning jumps among all the wet: causes nonstop Electrocuted.

name: Boiling Geyser
desc: Geysers of boiling water burst under the enemies and leave steam clouds that confuse and slow them.

name: Fiery Gale
desc: A gale of burning leaves sweeps a huge cone in front of you and sets the ground ablaze: causes Inferno.

fixed: Leaves three fire zones in a line.

name: Shattered Glacier
desc: You encase nearby enemies in ice and a brutal blow shatters it: causes Wreckage.

name: Toxic Combustion
desc: You exhale a cloud of poison gas that spreads toward the enemies; a spark ignites it and it explodes: causes Poison Gas.

fixed: The cloud appears at most 8 m from you.

name: Eternal Sleep
desc: A pendulum puts surrounding enemies to sleep and shadow hands strike the sleepers: causes Nightmare and heals you.

fixed: Heals you for 1.5% of your max HP.

name: Psychic Spark
desc: Four psychic orbs orbit around you linked by electric arcs that strike whatever they cross: causes Psychic Meltdown.

fixed: One orb shoots arcs at the nearest enemy up to 12 m away.

name: Enchanted Breath
desc: A rain of hearts charms the enemies ahead and a dragon breath devastates the charmed: causes Dragon Rage.

name: MissingNo.
desc: It's what you get from two unrelated moves (different types, with no reaction or signature fusion). It works: each time it's cast it becomes a random type's fusion, surrounded by corrupted blocks.
